name: mixed ecosystem batch assigned as one issue

contract: Every assignable work issue must correspond to exactly one independently mergeable pull request boundary
Never place GitHub Actions pin updates, ecosystem dependency updates for different package managers, or unrelated major upgrades in the same work issue
auth, crypto, payment, database, serialization, deserialization, telemetry, build tooling, CI runners, package managers, or container bases in the same work issue as routine updates
Never tell one assigned agent to produce more than one pull request, and never express isolation only as prose inside a combined issue
The umbrella plan issue is an inventory and index only. It must never be assigned to a coding agent
**Action:** Assign the linked work issues below to Copilot or another coding agent. Do not assign this umbrella issue.
Build one structured inventory before writing any issue text
Derive every count in every issue from that final inventory
never publish a summary whose per-ecosystem counts do not sum to the stated total or disagree with the checklist

name: upload-pages-artifact major upgrade drops hidden files

evidence.releaseNote: v4 excludes hidden files by default

contract: ## Major-version migration review
read the upstream release notes, changelog, and migration guide before declaring the update actionable
`actions/upload-pages-artifact` v4 and later exclude hidden files by default
published artifacts still containing intentionally published paths

name: duplicated literal action pin outside the canonical registry

contract: ## Canonical ownership of pins and manifests
Name the canonical manifest, lockfile, pin registry, or helper that produces the value
Prohibit direct edits to generated files and require regeneration through the repository's documented generator command
require the assigned agent to replace the duplicate with the shared mechanism instead of updating another literal copy

name: lockfile resolves beyond the reviewed target

contract: ## Version and lockfile discipline
The assigned agent may install only the exact target version unless the work issue explicitly authorizes a newer target
require the regenerated lockfile to resolve the reviewed packages to the exact reviewed versions
require inspecting the lockfile diff and reverting unrelated resolver churn before requesting review

name: candidate breaks peer range and adds advisories

contract: ## Candidate compatibility and security preflight
The absence of current Dependabot alerts is not sufficient evidence that a candidate version is safe or compatible
If the candidate falls outside a declared peer range, mark it `blocked`
If the candidate introduces a new high or critical severity advisory, mark it `blocked`
Never create a work issue for a candidate whose peer ranges or resolved graph disprove it

name: partial batch must not close the umbrella issue

contract: use `Part of #<issue>` when the pull request implements only part of this issue, and use `Fixes #<issue>` only when the pull request completely fulfills it
never use `Fixes` against the umbrella inventory issue, because a partial batch must never close it
keep the pull request title, description, checklist, and validation report synchronized with the final diff whenever review changes the scope
leave every unresolved or deferred update out of the pull request, keep its issue open, and report the deferral reason and remaining work on the issue
